description: ASTM D2699-15a (Research) and D2700-14 (Motor) guide tables of cylinder height (uncompensated digital counter / dial indicator) vs octane number at STANDARD KNOCK INTENSITY, 9/16 in venturi (MON also 19/32 and 3/4 in), at standard barometric pressure 29.92 in Hg (ASTM writes '101.0 kPa'; 29.92 in Hg = 101.32 kPa), barometric compensation tables, MON spark-timing table, converted to compression ratio with the project relation (src/physics/engines/cfr.ts cfrCompressionRatioAtCounter, rigid raise 0.0007 in/digit) and the Choi et al. 2018 polynomial (ANL engine, valid 400-1400). Octane numbers > 100 are iso-octane + TEL blends (D2699 3.1.19.2, Table A3.4) - not representable with PRF chemistry.

D2699.citation: ASTM D2699-15a, Standard Test Method for Research Octane Number of Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel

D2700.citation: ASTM D2700-14, Standard Test Method for Motor Octane Number of Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel

counterToCompressionRatio.rigidRaise: CR = 1 + S/(h930 - 0.0007 in (c - 930)), S = 4.5 in, h930 = 0.01742116238087605 m (cfr.ts CFR_CLEARANCE_HEIGHT_AT_BASIC_COUNTER, fitted to Choi 2018 Fig. 4 oil-measured CR)
counterToCompressionRatio.dialToCounter: equivalent counter = (1.012 - dial [in]) x 1410 (D2699 Table A4.3 footnote A; D2700 Table A4.3)
counterToCompressionRatio.caveat: The guide table fixes the cylinder HEIGHT; the CR at a given counter is engine-specific (indexed by the motored compression pressure of Fig. 2, cfr_astm_compression_pressure.json). Published ANL CR values differ between campaigns (e.g. RON 95 standard CR 7.26 in OSTI 2561394 vs 6.82 here).

RON.intakeAirTemperatureNote: at 29.92 in Hg; other barometers: Table A4.4/A4.5 IAT column
RON.fuelAirRatio: maximum knock intensity (fuel level 0.7-1.7 in above venturi centreline)

RON.rule: below 29.92 in Hg ADD the counter correction to the guide-table counter (higher CR), above 29.92 SUBTRACT; IAT column = required intake-air temperature at that barometer

MON.rule: as RON; no IAT change for MON (IAT fixed 38 C, mixture 149 C)

monSparkTiming.table: D2700-14 Table 3 (p. 10), uncompensated cylinder height; linear, 1 deg per ~73.4 counts
